other_conditions: Applicant must be domiciled in the state of Jharkhand
Applicant must be a registered Construction Worker (Nirmaan Shramik) or a member of the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)
Applicant must be engaged in construction work such as mason, carpenter, electrician, porter, painter, etc.
Applicant must have worked for at least 90 days
Applicant must not have already availed the benefits of this scheme
benefits_summary: A direct cash transfer of ₹1,000 is provided to beneficiaries to purchase a branded helmet and a pair of safety shoes.
